name: Seven broad reference regions with adaptive reporting

regions.geometry_recipe: Physical AFRICA south of 17 degrees north; a broad locator, not sample sites.
Physical NORTH AMERICA, SOUTH AMERICA and CENTRAL AMERICA; a broad locator, not sample sites.
Physical ASIA within 55–97 degrees east and 0–50 degrees north; a broad locator, not sample sites.
Physical ASIA east of 97 degrees east; a broad locator, not sample sites.
Physical EUROPE; a broad locator, not sample sites.
Physical AFRICA north of 17 degrees north plus ASIA west of 55 degrees east and south of 42 degrees north; a broad locator, not sample sites.
Physical MELANESIA within 129–157 degrees east and 11 degrees south–0, excluding physical AUSTRALIA; a western Melanesian locator, not sample sites. No Australia or Polynesia.
